messages.author: f703d8708831560b
messages.subject: histogram appears as screen junk
parts:
In have installed rattle on Ubuntu 12.04 w/R 3.1.1

I followed all the directions on
http://rattle.togaware.com/rattle-install-ubuntu.html

in particular, all the packages are installed without error (that took some doing!)

Under the Explore tab, I can successfully execute Box Plot, Cumulative, and Benford. 

Histogram fails because the plot windows is filled with screen junk, parts of whatever happens to be on my desktop.
In the terminal appears the message: Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'p' not found

The relevant part of the Log file follows.  Please help.

Regards,

Bruce



#============================================================
# Rattle timestamp: 2014-08-24 14:37:22 x86_64-pc-linux-gnu

# Histogram Plots

# The 'ggplot2' package provides the 'ggplot' function.

require(ggplot2, quietly=TRUE)

# The 'dplyr' package provides the 'select' function.

require(dplyr, quietly=TRUE)

# Histogram Plot for cohort_dom_filer

ar <- range(with(crs, select(dataset[sample,], cohort_dom_filer)))
bw <- (ar[2]-ar[1])/nclass.FD(with(crs, dataset[sample,]$cohort_dom_filer))

p <- p + geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..), binwidth=bw, fill="grey", colour="black")
p <- p + geom_density()

p <- p + xlab("cohort_dom_filer\n\nRattle 2014-Aug-24 14:37:22 bdm25")
p <- p + ggtitle("Distribution of cohort_dom_filer (sample)")
p <- p + labs(colour="") + xlab("Density")
print(p)

parts:
Thanks for reporting the bug.

I have identified a possible cause and have updated Rattle to version 3.1.5 on Togaware. You can download it as:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Let me know how you go.

Regards,
Graham
